method: Country-specific piecewise anchor histories using association structure, FIFA Big Count participation/access observations and temporally gated governance/development/competition milestones.
evidence_rules: FIFA Big Count all/registered-player and club observations support popularity/access only and remain mixed-sex/non-uniform source measurements.
Samoa preserves the 2010 inactivity/normalisation break and 2011 recovery instead of smoothing it away.
Tonga's current football popularity is constrained by explicit rugby-leading national context; regional Vava’u popularity is not treated as national.
Vanuatu's 2008 academy pilot and 2023 Forward infrastructure/pathway support development and elite-support only from their documented periods.
Competition outcomes are used only for competition/tradition context and never as universal six-attribute inputs.
Pre-foundation Samoa/Tonga years are explicit low-confidence backcasts; modern evidence is not used as direct historical support.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune authored ratings.
